# Stakeholder Business Case Template

## Stakeholder

Name the stakeholder.

## What's In It For Them?

Summarize the stakeholder-specific value in plain language.

## Problem Today

Describe the current pain or opportunity cost.

## Why They Would Participate

Why would this stakeholder choose to join, support, buy, operate, fund, or enable the program?

## Contribution

What does the program ask them to provide?

## Receives

What do they receive?

## Competitive Position

How does the stakeholder's position in its own market, institution, or ecosystem change if the program succeeds?

## Revenue Or Value Drivers

What revenue, avoided cost, strategic value, public-interest value, or ecosystem value may they gain?

## Success Indicators

How do we know the model is working before financial outcomes are fully visible?

Examples may include adoption, repeat usage, retention, participation, implementation time, support burden, satisfaction, value-added attachment rate, transaction completion rate, or other stakeholder-specific leading indicators.

## Costs

What costs do they incur?

## Risks

What risks do they assume?

## Responsibilities

What responsibilities do they own?

## Dependencies

What must be true?

## Five-Year Outcome

What does the scenario model show?

## If They Do Nothing

What happens without the program?

## Open Decisions

What remains unresolved?

## Validation Evidence

What evidence would prove or disprove the model?

## Contractual Or Regulatory Work

What formal work is required?
